metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly decompress your full back.

This is a perfect daily exercise to do to quickly get rid of back pain, tightness, and stiffness. It works by creating a traction (think a deep stretch) throughout the whole back to help open it up. 

Let us know how it works for you!

***************************
